verdict.headline: Your chat ads are earning clicks at {c:1202620000000005.ctr}.
verdict.body: Day 1 is a read on attention, and two of three creatives have it. Your CTR beats both of your last two launches on their first day: {cmp:0.moshi} against {cmp:0.merchant} and {cmp:1.merchant}. Purchases are too early to call.

items.text: Can I send it as a gift?

shopperThemes.text: Shoppers ask how far the scent travels. {m:chats} chats started so far at {m:costPerChat} each.
Some shoppers want delivery before a date.

quotes.text: Does the cedar one fill a small room?
Can I get the gift bundle before the 20th?

nextSteps.what: Check cost per chat and chat to product view at the next gate: {m:nextGate}.
Let the starved creative get its share of budget, then re-read its CTR.
Run scale-what-works if one creative keeps winning.

flags.text: Open cart value is unknown: carts carry no price.
